articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.snippet: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
articles.snippet: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

articles.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
articles.snippet: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
articles.snippet: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.
